title: Bloodbreaker: Labyrinth of the Witch Demo
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#343, 2026-10-05), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.8, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, D3DMetal, rated 4 of 5 after 5 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on D3DMetal, where four GameMaker error boxes come up before the game starts and the game plays after OK on each. On an M4 the demo started on DXMT went straight to its Choose a Language screen with no box, while D3DMetal stopped at the first box, so DXMT is the mode to use. The game itself was not played here. The full game is a separate Steam app (3530380), not tested.

knownIssues.symptom: Four boxes saying 'Win32 function failed: HRESULT 0x80070057' from GR_D3D_Device->CheckMultisampleQualityLevels before the game starts
knownIssues.cause: The game is made with GameMaker, whose runner shows every failed graphics query in a box. Asked for 8 or more samples, D3DMetal answers Direct3D 11's multisample quality query with E_INVALIDARG, where Windows, DXMT and DXVK answer success with zero quality levels (measured on an M4 with engine r21, 2026-10-05)
knownIssues.fix: Set the game to DXMT on its page, which goes straight to the game (seen on an M4). On D3DMetal, press OK on each box and the game starts and plays (highball-db#343)

dxmt.detail: reaches the Choose a Language screen with no error box (M4, macOS 27.0, engine r21, 2026-10-06); not played further

d3dmetal.detail: a GameMaker box 'Win32 function failed 0x80070057, CheckMultisampleQualityLevels' before the game starts, four times by the player's report; OK on each lets it play

verified.how: Steam copy started through Highball's launch path on an M4 on 2026-10-06, engine r21. On DXMT the Choose a Language screen came up with no error box. On D3DMetal the GameMaker box 'Win32 function failed 0x80070057, CheckMultisampleQualityLevels' came up first. Nothing past the first screen was played.
